hotel.name: Serenia Lake Resort

hero.label: LAKESIDE WILDERNESS RETREAT
hero.title: Where Tranquility Meets Unmatched Elegance
hero.description: Disconnect from the ordinary and immerse yourself in pristine nature, private lakeside villas, and world-class spa therapies.

story.subtitle: The Sanctuary
story.title: A Harmonious Blend of Wilderness & Luxury
story.description: Every villa and pavilion is architecturally crafted to frame breathtaking lake reflections and towering pine forests while offering modern opulent comforts.

rooms.name: Pine View Lakeside Room
rooms.description: A cozy, light-filled sanctuary overlooking the misty pine tree canopy and gentle lake waters.

rooms.name: Overwater Pool Villa
rooms.description: Luxurious standalone villa extending over the lake with a private plunge pool and sun deck.

rooms.name: The Grand Serenia Estate
rooms.description: Multi-bedroom ultra-luxury estate with private dock, outdoor dining pavilion, and dedicated chef.

amenities.title: Serenia Spa & Wellness
amenities.description: Rejuvenating holistic therapies, yoga pavilions, and hydrotherapy pools overlooking the water.

amenities.title: Infinity Lakeside Pool
amenities.description: Heated infinity pool seamlessly merging into the scenic horizon of the blue lake.

amenities.title: Artisanal Teahouse
amenities.description: Savor single-origin mountain teas and organic pastries amidst botanical gardens.

amenities.title: Nature Concierge
amenities.description: Customized kayaking, hiking tours, and stargazing sessions guided by local experts.

dining.name: The Canopy Restaurant
dining.description: Seasonal menus crafted from our organic greenhouse produce and locally sourced ingredients.

dining.name: The Waters Edge Wine Lounge
dining.description: Hand-selected vintage wines and artisanal cheeses served by the crackling lakeside fire pit.

offers.title: Mindful Weekend Retreat

experiences.title: Private Sunset Kayaking
experiences.description: Glide across mirror-like lake waters as the sun sets behind the forested mountains.

testimonials.review: The most peaceful retreat I have ever experienced. Exceptional service, pristine nature, and world-class spa.

footer.description: An immersive wilderness resort dedicated to mindful luxury, pristine nature, and holistic wellness.
